_meta.title: Human-annotated relationship ground truth for the e-commerce multi-table golden set
_meta.annotated_by: M4 eval week (M6.1 T3); annotator: Claude agent, reviewed against raw CSV contents
_meta.direction_semantics: left = referencing (fact/FK) side, right = referenced (dimension/PK) side; a prediction only counts as a true positive in this FK direction
annotation_basis: Schema semantics: orders is the fact table; customer_id and product_id are foreign keys by naming and by role (each order references one customer and one product).

Data facts, hand-derived from the CSVs: orders.customer_id -> customers.customer_id: customers holds CU001-CU005 with CU004 duplicated (6 rows / 5 distinct), and orders contains CU999 absent from customers. Hence LEFT JOIN yields 9 rows for 8 orders (O1005 matches the CU004 pair) = multiplier 1.125; left orphan rate 1/8 = 0.125; cardinality many-to-many because both sides repeat keys. This is the deliberate join trap (M4 plan §7 W1, R17 golden design).
orders.product_id -> products.product_id: products.product_id is unique (4/4), every ordered product exists, so multiplier 1.0, orphan rates 0.0, cardinality many-to-one. This is the clean FK.

Negatives: region appears in customers and marketing but is a low-cardinality dimension attribute (4 distinct values over 6 rows on both sides), not a key: joining on it fans out. Reverse directions of the two true FKs point at a non-unique right side and must not be adopted as FKs. order_id/campaign_id/product_id cross pairs share an alnum-code shape but have zero value overlap.
_meta.expected_engine_readings: expected_validation numbers below are exact, hand-computed from the CSV contents and asserted with a 1e-6 tolerance

true_relations.basis: True FK with two seeded traps: duplicated CU004 on the right (inflates joins) and orphan CU999 on the left. Must be surfaced for HITL (medium), never auto-adopted.

Clean FK: full containment, unique right side, no orphans. Cleanly joinable, but under the reference-only relationship policy (PR #5 / decision-intelligence design: a join is a deliberate choice inside an approved analysis plan) no relationship auto-adopts — it is surfaced as a high-confidence reference, never merged automatically.

negative_relations.basis: Shared low-cardinality dimension attribute; joining on it fans out (not a key).
Same dimension pair in the other direction.
Reverse of a true FK: right side (orders) repeats customer ids, so this direction is not a FK adoption target.
Reverse of the clean FK; right side is non-unique.
Format-similar alnum codes with zero value overlap; classic false-positive bait.
